sections.heading: Planning your One Leonie Residences interior
sections.text:
Leonie Hill is a tight, established residential pocket just off the Orchard belt. Homes here are usually judged on finish and on how carefully the plan is used, because the setting is prime and the rooms are rarely generous without good joinery. That is a natural brief for Maison: built-in carpentry at the entry, a living-room joinery wall, a fitted kitchen, and full-height wardrobes, with a headboard wall in the main bedroom if the plan allows it. We present the work the way a professional interior is seen, including closer shots of materials and junctions, not only a wide show-flat angle, and we do not use IKEA-style flat-pack furniture as the backbone of the home.

No official floor plan is on file, so typologies and room sizes are not listed, and we will not invent a typical One Leonie plan. River Modern, Duet @ Emily, Orchard Sophia and CanningHill Piers are other Maison pages in or next to District 9; they are nearby links, not typologies references. We will not promise an Orchard or river outlook from your stack. Check the key plan, the facing, and the management rules before you plan blinds, a bench or any balcony work.

Until a launch and typologies are confirmed in our file, this page stays conservative on figures. If you already have sale documents or a plan, WhatsApp Maison and we will work from those. After keys, inspect defects, measure, and obtain renovation approval before fabrication. A moderate carpentry scope is often planned at about six to ten weeks on site after approvals — an editorial allowance, not a guarantee. We are not affiliated with Far East Organization.
